Reels & Video Editor – AI Content Creator — Lembark Solutions, Surat
Responsibilities:
- Create engaging Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and social media videos.
- Edit videos with good transitions, captions, music, effects, and storytelling.
- Create UGC, promotional, and marketing videos.
- Follow the latest social media trends.
- Use AI tools to create videos, images, scripts, voiceovers, captions, and other content.
- Work with the marketing team to create creative content.
Requirements:
- Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar tools.
- Good understanding of short-form video content.
- Basic knowledge of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Kling, Veo or similar tools is a plus.
- Creative mindset and ability to meet deadlines.
- Portfolio of previous work is required.
